title: Improve diagnostics lifecycle overview
summary: Redesigned the Diagnostics lifecycle overview into structured close-readiness and backend lifecycle callouts, compact fact rows, and a recent backend.shutdown evidence table while preserving the existing raw text sinks.
reason: The prior lifecycle panel mixed the operator status, blocking reason, and raw command evidence in long prose blocks, making the shutdown posture hard to scan during diagnostics.
behavior_before: Diagnostics showed close-readiness and backend lifecycle data primarily as raw preformatted text, with backend shutdown history rendered as stacked command lines.
behavior_after: Diagnostics shows a primary lifecycle callout, compact safe/state/watcher/reason facts, a structured backend shutdown evidence table, and collapsed raw details for compatibility and deeper evidence review.
